//: ML / Kaggle experiment project: the ONE file to configure. Made by `python v2.py new <Name> --ml --repo <path> --metric <m>`; then write issues.yaml, `v2.py check`, `v2.py issues`, `v2.py run`. Each issue is one experiment, committed only if the ML gate approves and the adversary does not veto.
repo: TODO: absolute path to the experiment repo's git checkout

run.//: Training is slow and quiet: long sessions, a generous stall window, fewer retries.

ml.//: Deterministic ML gate (ml_gate.py): the only thing that can approve an experiment. Paths are relative to the repo. Test data is sha256-locked automatically on the first passing experiment.
ml.//plausibility: plausible_max ~ the public leaderboard best (above it = leakage). max_jump = the largest one-experiment gain you'd believe unreviewed.
ml.//reproduce: The gate re-runs the frozen eval on saved predictions and uses its own number. null = trust results_file.

adversary.//: Veto-only reviewer (adversary.py). Needs GEMINI_API_KEY; without it every review is logged UNREVIEWED and nothing is blocked. Priors are context only.

scope.//: Deterministic scope gate (integrity/integrity.py gate) records which changes fall outside the issue's **Scope:** line. Keep report mode: a study of 232 past commits found most out-of-scope changes were legitimate ripple effects or doc updates. Tests, docs and .env.example are allowed by default; agent config (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/, .mcp.json) and *.bak files are always flagged unless scoped. Override with allow_globs / protect_globs.

refs.//: Dangling reference check (integrity/integrity.py refs): fails when a change removes a function, class or constant that other code still uses. Needs no scope. Enforced: on 232 past commits it flagged 5, all real breakages the tests missed. Add false alarms to ignore: [...]; set mode to report to only record.

record.//: Decision record check (integrity/integrity.py record): the issue's record (docs/decisions/NNNN-slug.md) must exist with every section; the check appends a tool-verified facts block and warns where the rationale and the diff disagree. Enforce fails only on a missing record or missing sections.
